title: NemotronLabs VoiceChat: An Open Full-duplex Speech-to-Speech Model with Tool Calling Capabilities
title_zh: NemotronLabs VoiceChat：具备工具调用能力的开放式全双工语音到语音模型
abstract_en: We introduce NemotronLabs VoiceChat, an open full-duplex speech-to-speech model with native tool-calling capabilities. NemotronLabs VoiceChat combines a streaming speech encoder and decoder-only language model with parallel specialized output streams for agent text and structured function calls, an auxiliary RNN-T branch for incremental user transcription, and a streaming TTS decoder. This design enables the model to listen, transcribe, reason, invoke tools, and speak within a unified streaming architecture while preserving the temporal behavior required for natural conversation. On Full-Duplex-Bench 1.0, NemotronLabs VoiceChat achieves the lowest pause-handling takeover rates among evaluated open-weight systems, 100\% takeover following user interruptions, and a 4.33/5 post-interruption response-quality score. On Full-Duplex-Bench 1.5, it resumes its response after user backchannels in 93\% of cases. NemotronLabs VoiceChat obtains a 55.1 normalized average on VoiceBench and, on Full-Duplex-Bench 3.0 (FDB 3.0), achieves 82.5\% tool-selection F1, while argument accuracy and end-to-end tool execution remain areas for improvement. These results demonstrate that full-duplex interaction, speech recognition and generation, general language capabilities, and external tool use can be integrated in a single open speech-to-speech model without sacrificing real-time conversational behavior.
abstract_zh: 论文提出 NemotronLabs VoiceChat，一种具备原生工具调用能力的开放式全双工 speech-to-speech 模型。模型将流式语音编码器、decoder-only language model、多路并行输出流、辅助 RNN-T 增量转写分支与流式 TTS 解码器统一起来，可在单一流式架构中完成监听、转写、推理、工具调用和语音生成，同时保持自然对话所需的时序行为。在 Full-Duplex-Bench 1.0 上，模型在暂停处理接管率方面领先开放权重系统，用户打断后的接管率达到 100%，中断后响应质量为 4.33/5；在 Full-Duplex-Bench 1.5 上，对用户附和语的响应恢复率为 93%。模型在 VoiceBench 上取得 55.1 的归一化平均分，并在 Full-Duplex-Bench 3.0 上达到 82.5% 的工具选择 F1。但参数准确率和端到端工具执行能力仍有提升空间。结果表明，全双工交互、语音识别与生成、通用语言能力及外部工具使用可以集成到同一个开放式 speech-to-speech 模型中，同时保持实时对话表现。
key_points_zh: 采用统一流式架构，整合语音编码、语言推理、增量转写、工具调用和 TTS 生成。
通过并行输出流分别生成 agent 文本与结构化函数调用，并利用辅助 RNN-T 分支实现实时用户转写。
在 Full-Duplex-Bench 1.0 和 1.5 上展现较强的打断处理与响应恢复能力，支持自然全双工交互。
在 Full-Duplex-Bench 3.0 上工具选择 F1 达到 82.5%，但参数准确率和端到端执行仍是瓶颈。
结果验证了开放式 speech-to-speech 模型同时具备全双工对话、通用语言能力和外部工具使用能力的可行性。

llm_assessment.comment: A highly relevant open full-duplex voice-agent architecture that unifies streaming conversation, interruption handling, and native tool calling with strong reusable evaluation.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作以开放统一架构整合流式语音交互、中断处理和原生工具调用，具有很高的领域相关性与复用价值。
